renderingRules: Use the exact reference crop bounds for each region. Preserve the reference aspect ratio; use contain/letterboxing rather than stretching.
Generated terrain must be checked against this reference before precise overlay alignment is claimed. Coordinates match the official reference, not unverified generated pixels.
Published symbol anchors may be labeled on world/regional maps; venues, rooms, Waterdeep wards and ten-town settlements without individual reference symbols belong on lower-level maps.
Polygon edges are approximate geographic footprints, never political borders or discovery boundaries.
For III/I separate shared Waterdeep world coordinate with leader lines or city inset. Walking Tower has no fixed marker; Broken Star marks an approach area only.
Show approximate adventure transfers and custom proposals with distinct visual treatment. Never imply discovered/visited from map preparation.
Do not fabricate Loudwater city position; omit its marker or present a text-only unresolved approach note.
limits: No full-PDF page-by-page inspection was undertaken. Specific visual pages and text-only sources are listed separately.
Official image inspected across the six specified crop regions; the broad western Sword Coast footprint is covered, not every settlement or feature on the entire continental reference.
467 canonical locations are not all geolocated. Urban venues, dungeon rooms, offshore islands beyond scope, alternative Tales placements and out-of-region sites are intentionally unplaced.
Loudwater is not labeled on the inspected official map. Northern ten-town cities have no individually verified symbols here.

All manually entered polylines are generalized drawing aids; they omit bends, tributaries, road junctions and coast inlets. Route availability, crossing safety and river navigability are not established by a line on this register.
Triboar exists as a reference anchor with null locationId because it is absent from the supplied 467-location canonical register. Several named forests similarly remain geographic features only.
Tales from the Yawning Portal suggested Forgotten Realms placements remain optional book adaptations. No fixed master pins were created for them.
